# Space Papers contributor instructions

Read `HANDOFF_COPILOT.md` first. Preserve the domain rules and accounting in `src/catalog.ts` and `src/domain.ts` unless the team explicitly requests a rule change. Keep outcome and future-emergency information hidden until the appropriate reveal. Do not add runtime network calls; NASA references are archived in `public/science.json`, and fictional game balance is not NASA data. Build for children aged 7–12 with legible text, clear actions, keyboard support and reduced motion. Keep the supplied layered 2.5D Blender room and its room/desk camera relationship. Avoid machine-specific paths, private links and secrets. Test changes with `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`, and the relevant browser suites described in README. Distinguish shipped behavior, supplied assets and future work accurately.

The tracked root `index.html` is generated as a self-contained offline game. Do not edit it manually: use `pnpm build` to regenerate it and `dist/index.html`. `dev.html` is the development source entry. Players must be able to open the root file directly without a server, installation, login, network request or external asset. Updated room/font and planet work is deferred.
